Hey! Don't you feel sorry for them?!

You didn't? Seriously...
Wait, what?
Yeah, I've been blind since birth and I've to\nrely on magic to see...
I can raise the accuracy to sense enemies behind\nme like I did before, but keeping the accuracy\nhigh will drain my stamina.
I usually just keep it to a minimum necessary for\nme to roughly tell the shape of things, therefore\nI can't sense meager things like flowers...
Oh, really? I didn't know that...
It mustn't have been easy to bloom.\nI feel so bad now, I'm sorry.
